## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle abridged *yíguǐ* 儀軌 setting out the recitation-practice for the *Mahā-karuṇā-dhāraṇī* of [KR6j0260](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0260). The colophon names the translator as **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)), 唐北天竺三藏沙門大廣智. Although the *yíguǐ* genre is best categorised as a translated *kalpa* manual, in practice this abridgement was prepared at the *Dàxìngshànsì* 大興善寺 in the late Tángmì period as a compact recitation-practice handbook based on the *Vajra-śekhara* method.

**Abstract**

The opening ("依灌頂道場經，說修陀羅尼法門") explicitly grounds the manual in the *Guàndǐng dàocháng* — the *Abhiṣeka-maṇḍala* — apparatus of the Tangmí *Vajra-śekhara* lineage, situating the *Mahā-karuṇā-dhāraṇī* recitation within the *yoga-tantra* sādhanā framework rather than as a stand-alone popular spell. The procedure prescribed: (1) entry into the bodhi-citta and *saṃvara-śīla* of the Buddhas; (2) abhiṣeka into the maṇḍala; (3) self-generation as Avalokiteśvara through visualisation; (4) recitation of the *Mahā-karuṇā-dhāraṇī* together with the forty-two principal mudrās of the deity; (5) closing dedication and *visarjana*. The work belongs with [KR6j0269](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0269) (Amoghavajra's full *Mahā-karuṇā* translation) and [KR6j0273](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0273) (Amoghavajra's full maṇḍala-manual) as the *yíguǐ* triad of the Tángmì *Sahasrabhuja* cycle. CANWWW (T20N1066) places the work alongside [KR6j0260](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0260) as the parent text and the maṇḍala-manuals.
